instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '物理风险 (极端天气/海平面)'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业识别了哪些急性物理风险（如台风、洪水、热浪）？ 是否识别海平面上升、长期高温等慢性风险？ 是否评估关键资产、运营点或供应链暴露？ 是否披露适应措施、加固改造或应急恢复安排？ 是否有量化暴露或损失评估？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有转型风险（政策、诉讼、融资）；仅有减排目标；仅有泛化气候风险管理而无物理风险内容；仅有社区防灾公益项目而无企业资产风险；区分：物理风险聚焦极端天气与海平面等物理影响及适应措施；转型风险聚焦政策法律资金变化；场景分析是评估方法，可服务物理与转型风险，但不能替代具体物理风险识别与适应披露；TCFD披露是框架完整性，不等于本指标内容充分。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE EMPLOYER / Health and safety
results.text: In the daily work, the Group and each Production Plant upload problems to WeChat in a timely manner with the help of WeChat and constantly update the treatment progress, and security departments of the Production Plants follow up the information from WeChat, thus ensuring that problems are dealt with in a close end cycle from discovery to resolution. In addition to the basic health and safety regulations and systems, Ju Teng International has also formulated the 'Risk Assessment and Control Management Procedures', 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Procedures' and 'Production Safety Accident Emergency Management System' according to its own industry characteristics. Regarding the management of hazardous chemicals, we strictly control the whole process (transportation, storage and custody, entry and exit, use and post-processing) of hazardous products in accordance with the 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Regulations' and internal management procedures. In addition, the Group's various safety systems enable the Group identify the risk sources in the process of production, services and activities, control the risks in all links, and take measures to influence the possible hazards, so that the risks can be controlled effectively to achieve the policy of 'Safety First, Prevention First, and Comprehensive Management'.

[Section]
RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE EMPLOYER / Health and safety

[Content]
In the daily work, the Group and each Production Plant upload problems to WeChat in a timely manner with the help of WeChat and constantly update the treatment progress, and security departments of the Production Plants follow up the information from WeChat, thus ensuring that problems are dealt with in a close end cycle from discovery to resolution. In addition to the basic health and safety regulations and systems, Ju Teng International has also formulated the 'Risk Assessment and Control Management Procedures', 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Procedures' and 'Production Safety Accident Emergency Management System' according to its own industry characteristics. Regarding the management of hazardous chemicals, we strictly control the whole process (transportation, storage and custody, entry and exit, use and post-processing) of hazardous products in accordance with the 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Regulations' and internal management procedures. In addition, the Group's various safety systems enable the Group identify the risk sources in the process of production, services and activities, control the risks in all links, and take measures to influence the possible hazards, so that the risks can be controlled effectively to achieve the policy of 'Safety First, Prevention First, and Comprehensive Management'.

results.section: ABOUT JU TENG INTERNATIONAL / Company overview
results.text: Established in 2000, Ju Teng International is a casing manufacturer specialising in 3C products. Its major customers include HP, Dell, Acer and Asus and its production bases cover Eastern China, Western China and Taiwan. After 21 years of endeavours, Ju Teng International have been well recognised by our customers. In 2021, the global economy experienced a downward trend due to the continuous effect of the outbreak of the 2019 Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. However, the pandemic has increased the demand for remote working and learning. Remote working and learning have become a new trend in lifestyle and have driven the development of the personal computer market, also bringing new opportunities and challenges to the Group. Taking advantage of this market opportunity, we take the initiative to improve the level of R&D and core competitiveness, while remaining cautious in the face of risks and uncertainties, adjusting our strategies flexibly and growing steadily in the midst of challenges.

ABOUT JU TENG INTERNATIONAL / Company overview

[Content]
Established in 2000, Ju Teng International is a casing manufacturer specialising in 3C products. Its major customers include HP, Dell, Acer and Asus and its production bases cover Eastern China, Western China and Taiwan. After 21 years of endeavours, Ju Teng International have been well recognised by our customers. In 2021, the global economy experienced a downward trend due to the continuous effect of the outbreak of the 2019 Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. However, the pandemic has increased the demand for remote working and learning. Remote working and learning have become a new trend in lifestyle and have driven the development of the personal computer market, also bringing new opportunities and challenges to the Group. Taking advantage of this market opportunity, we take the initiative to improve the level of R&D and core competitiveness, while remaining cautious in the face of risks and uncertainties, adjusting our strategies flexibly and growing steadily in the midst of challenges.

results.text: Ju Teng International formulated the 'Environment-Related Substance Reduction Plan Form', which imposes strict requirements on the suppliers to ban the use of heavy metals, formaldehyde, ozone hazardous substances, radioactive substances and so on. In order to restrict suppliers from using prohibited materials or chemical substances in the production process and on the products, parts and packaging materials provided to Ju Teng International, Ju Teng International has signed the 'Environmental Protection Agreement' with suppliers. In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.
